description:
REFRAMED per the owner's sorting law (2026-07-02): sorting is a BARRIER operation — it requires ALL elements, so a mid-flow sort entrenches pass-based thinking. The fix is NOT cheaper sort keys; it is REMOVING sorts from the flow. (The northstar sorting rules already forbid this: sorting never decides anchoring/merging/visitation/inclusion; it is legitimate only for final dense packaging or presentation of a complete product.)

THE MEASURED SITES (census, ~50% of per-solve unit cost, 4101/8170 samples on 00420): executable_sort_key (transport.rs:1819) -> input_structure_key (:1815) formats types to display STRINGS per input, Vec<String> keys recomputed per comparison via sort_by_key; outgoing_input_edge_waits (:938-952) sorts the ENTIRE executable set on every expansion iteration JUST to order waits (:779, :810); further sorts at :840, :961, :997.

WORK — classify every sort site in the transport flow (and any the .18.28.1 keystone leaves standing):
1. FLOW-BARRIER sorts (eliminate): anything ordering a set to drive derivation, wait emission, anchoring, or merging. Waits need no order (the driver dedups; if deterministic wait order genuinely matters, that is a scheduler property to establish once, not a per-iteration whole-set sort). Replace with order-independent accumulation (sets/keyed maps/joins).
2. PRESENTATION/FINAL-PACKAGING sorts (keep): sorting an already-complete product for deterministic output or dense indices — give these cheap structural keys (interned ids via sort_by_cached_key), never display strings (string keys also encode interner fragility, ShapeId-is-pure-layout).
3. Verify none of the kept sorts feeds back into semantics (the old executable_sort_key anchor-gate pattern is the cautionary case).

SEQUENCING: blocked by fz-go4.18.28.1 (the keystone removes most solve iterations; re-measure what survives, then classify+fix the remainder). ACCEPTANCE: zero flow-barrier sorts in the transport path (rg audit of sort_by* with per-site classification in the commit body); products byte-identical; suite green 3x under the 2m bound; per-solve unit cost re-measured.
title: Transport sorts format types into display-string keys per comparison
